# Gaston Day School — Summer Programs (2026 Camp Catalog)

**Provenance**

- **Compiled by:** Claude Code deep research pass (`/implement add-gaston-day`).
- **Date compiled:** 2026-08-18
- **Method:** The summer-programs web page names the camp categories but inlines **no**
 dates, ages or prices — all of it sits in a linked Google Doc catalog that returns only a
 JS shell to a normal fetch. **The working path is the Google Docs plain-text export
 endpoint:** append `/export?format=txt` to the document URL in place of `/edit`. That
 returned the complete **"2026 Summer Camps at Gaston Day Catalog"**, transcribed below.
 This is the document the plan identified as the single unlock for this area's coverage.
- **School:** Gaston Day School, Gastonia, NC.
- **Directors:** **Lulu Brase, Julie Dellibovi, Ben Tipton.** Contact
 **summercamps@gastonday.org**, 704-864-7744. Vendor/partner camps: **Ben Tipton**
 (BTipton@gastonday.org).
- **All grade levels below are "rising grades"** — the student's grade for the 2026-27
 school year, as the catalog states.
- **Open to non-students:** "You do not have to be a student at Gaston Day to participate in
 summer camps!"

**Prices:** Full Day (includes lunch) **$300** · Half Day **$175**.
***Week 3 camp — $240 full day and $140 half-day*** (short week; no camp June 19th).

| Camp | Rising grades | Dates | Times |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Camp Spartan!** | Rising **1st–5th** | June 1-5, June 8-12, June 15-18, July 6-10, July 13-17, July 20-24, July 27-31 | Full day **8:30am-3:30pm**; Half day AM **8:30-12pm** or PM **12:30-3:30pm** |
| **Camp Spartan! Jr** | Rising **PK–K** | June 1-5, June 8-12, June 15-18, June 22-26, July 6-10, July 13-17, July 20-24, July 27-31 | Full day **8:30am-3:30pm**; Half day AM **8:30-12pm** or PM **12:30-3:30pm** |

**Exclusions.** Camp Spartan: no camp June 19th, the week of June 22nd, or the week of
June 29th. Camp Spartan Jr: no camp June 19th or the week of June 29th; no PM-only camp the
week of June 22nd.

**Drop-off/pick-up.** Camp Spartan — drop off 8:30-9:00am, pick up 11:30-12:30 or
3:00-3:30pm. Camp Spartan Jr — drop off 8:30-9:00am, pick up 12:00-12:30 or 3:00-3:30pm.
Both are described as "a great option for working parents who need summer child care."

**Registered separately from the camps themselves.**

| Option | Window | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Before Camp Care** | **7:45am-8:30am** | **$25** |
| **After Camp Care** | **3:30pm-5:00pm** | **$35** |
| **Between Camp Lunch Care** | **11:30am-12:30pm** | **$40 a week** |

Before Camp Care allows drop-off at any point in the window. After Camp Care times are
"flexible with the time your camp ends." **Lunch Care is REQUIRED** for campers staying on
campus between morning and afternoon sessions, and includes lunch from **Sparty's Dining
Service**; it is already included for full-day Camp Spartan and Camp Spartan Jr campers.

**Full wrap-around span: 7:45am – 5:00pm.**

sections.text:
- **Registration** for Camp Spartan and GDS enrichment camps runs through the **Popsicle**
 app. Links go live for GDS families **Monday, Feb. 9th at noon**. Families may return to
 add camps as their summer takes shape.
- **Payment:** full tuition payment is required **at time of enrollment**, through Popsicle.
 Charlotte Children's Theater pays through its own website; Legends and Studio Elite bill
 by email from Ben Tipton.
- **Refunds:** **50%** of tuition is refundable if cancelled **three weeks or more** before
 the camp starts. Cancellations later than three weeks before the given week are **not
 refunded**. No refunds for arriving late or leaving early.
- **Cancellation by the school:** Gaston Day reserves the right to cancel any camp with
 insufficient enrolment, with a **minimum two-week notice**; camps cancelled for
 insufficient enrolment **are refunded**.

sections.text:
This catalog closes what the plan identified as this area's principal gap — session dates,
ages, times and prices are all now sourced rather than absent. Weeks run **June 1 through
July 31, 2026** (**8 numbered weeks**, with no camp the week of June 29th and none on
June 19th); ages span **rising PK through rising 12th** (tutoring) and **8–17** (Nike
camps); the care span is **7:45am–5:00pm**.
